app.name: Frejsi
app.footer: Frejsi · open source · never calculates insulin

shell.noSpaceTitle: You're not in a space right now
shell.noSpaceBody: Ask an owner for a new invitation and you'll be back in.

soon.title: Coming in a later version
soon.body: This part of Frejsi isn't ready yet. Everything else works as it should.

viewer.notice: As a viewer you can see today's meals and carbohydrates. Blood sugar is not shown here.
viewer.mealsSoon: Meals are coming in a later version.

page.title: Something went wrong
page.body: It's nothing you did. Try again – and if it keeps happening, give it a little while and try later.

notFound.title: That page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the page has moved. Go to the front page and you're on safe ground.

api.forbidden: You don't have access to this. Ask an owner of the space if you think you should.
api.not-found: What you're looking for doesn't exist – or you don't have access to it.
api.invite-expired: The invitation has expired. Ask for a new one – it only takes a moment.
api.invite-used: The invitation has already been used. If that wasn't you, ask for a new one.
api.invite-revoked: The invitation has been withdrawn. Ask the person who sent it.
api.last-owner: A space always needs at least one owner, so the last owner can't be removed.
api.source-bad-credentials: The username or password doesn't match. Try again.
api.source-unreachable: We couldn't reach the source right now. Try again in a little while.
api.validation: Something in what you entered couldn't be used. Look it over and try again.
api.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitleOwner: {space} · only owners can change things here
settings.subtitleMember: You can change your own language, view and colour

source.lead: Where Frejsi gets {subject}'s readings from. One source at a time.
source.cardConnected: Connected · last reading {when} · {region} · fetches every 5 minutes
source.cardConnectedNoReading: Connected · no readings yet · {region} · fetches every 5 minutes
source.vaultNote: The {source} login is kept in a locked vault, never in the database. Owners are told if the connection has been down for more than 35 minutes.

connect.title: Change login
connect.lead: Sign in with the account the sensor app shares from. Frejsi keeps the login in a locked vault only – never in the database.

targetRange.label: Target range
targetRange.crossed: The lower bound must be below the upper bound.

simpleMode.lead: Large, picture-based and verified food only. Per person.
simpleMode.leadDesktop: Large, picture-based and verified food only. Turned on per person – it is a view, not a role.

colour.title: Colour
colour.lead: Each person picks their own colour. It only changes how things look – never what a number means.
colour.note: Meals are always terracotta and the number is always black – whatever the colour. {name} can also switch under More.
colour.noteSelf: Meals are always terracotta and the number is always black – whatever the colour.

passkey.cancelled: That didn't go through this time. Try again when you're ready.
passkey.unsupported: This browser can't use passkeys. Try a newer browser, or open the link on your phone.
passkey.failed: That didn't work this time. Try again in a moment.

roleExplained.owner: You can do everything – people, devices and settings included.
roleExplained.carer: You can log meals, verify food and see the curve.
roleExplained.viewer: You can see today's meals and carbohydrates. Blood sugar is not shown.

invite.deviceExplained: {inviter} sent you the link so this device can sign in as you too. You keep your role in the space.

phone.noPassword: No password. You sign in with your face or your finger.
phone.newPhone: A new phone later? Ask {inviter} or another owner for a new link.

desktop.noPassword: No password and no email. You sign in with Windows Hello, Touch ID or your phone.
desktop.alsoPhone: Want to use your phone as well? Ask {inviter} for an “add device” link afterwards.

invite.failed: That didn't work this time. Try again – and if it keeps happening, ask for a new link.
invite.alreadyRegistered: This device can already sign in as you. Sign in instead, or open the link on the phone or computer you want to add.
invite.expires: The link is valid for {days, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}} and can be used only once.

unavailable.title: This link no longer works
unavailable.invite-expired: The link has expired. An invitation link is valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
unavailable.invite-used: The link has already been used. An invitation link can be used only once.
unavailable.invite-revoked: The link was withdrawn by the person who sent it.
unavailable.whoCanHelp: The person who sent you the link – or another owner of the space – can send you a new one. It only takes a moment.

welcome.title: Welcome back
welcome.body: Sign in with your face, your finger or your phone – like last time.
welcome.failed: We don't know that passkey. Is this a new phone or computer? Then ask an owner of the space for an “add device” link.
welcome.firstTimeBody: Then you need an invitation link from an owner of the space. Open the link on the phone or computer you want to use.
